mapper.sql: id, tenant_id, task_id, plan_revision_id, plan_version, artifact_id, file_version_no, reference_key, artifact_fact_version, reference_fact_version, availability_fact_version, scope_version, sha256, generated_at, creator
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cut_plan_generated_file () SELECT #{row.id}, #{row.tenantId}, #{row.taskId}, #{row.planRevisionId}, #{row.planVersion}, #{row.artifactId}, #{row.fileVersionNo}, #{row.referenceKey}, #{row.artifactFactVersion}, #{row.referenceFactVersion}, #{row.availabilityFactVersion}, #{row.scopeVersion}, #{row.sha256}, #{row.generatedAt}, #{row.creator} FROM cut_plan_revision p WHERE p.tenant_id = #{row.tenantId} AND p.id = #{row.planRevisionId} AND p.task_id = #{row.taskId} AND p.version = #{row.planVersion} AND p.status_code = 'DRAFT' AND p.current_marker = 1 AND p.deleted = b'0' AND p.edit_mode_code IN ('ONLINE_TEMPLATE_STANDARD', 'ONLINE_TEMPLATE_SIMPLE_D')
